title: Adaptive Control of Scientific Instruments with Nonstationary Responses through Multimodal Agents
title_zh: 基于多模态智能体对非平稳响应科学仪器的自适应控制

paragraphs.en: Controlling scientific instruments requires parameters to be adjusted progressively in response to feedback from successive operations. When unobserved operating conditions evolve with operational history, responses become nonstationary, and a static action–response mapping becomes inadequate for decision-making across shots. Shot-to-shot tuning of neutral beam injection (NBI) ion sources in magnetic-confinement fusion devices is representative of this class of problems: electrode-surface and vacuum conditions are difficult to observe directly, discharge outcomes vary between shots, and experiments on the physical system are costly and carry operational risks. We propose a physics-grounded multimodal agent organized into three independently auditable components. Deterministic algorithms extract symbolic physical quantities and visual evidence from multichannel waveforms; a dual-layer memory organizes within-task trajectories, cross-task experience, and procedural knowledge to support candidate-action generation by a multimodal large language model (MLLM); and an independent action feasibility check enforces action constraints before execution. The MLLM thus integrates evidence and proposes actions, while measurement, action authorization, and final protection remain with deterministic modules. In a strictly chronological replay of 455 shots from four EXL-50U platforms, physical symbols alone outperformed waveform images alone by 0.21–0.32 in quality-classification macro-F 1 across all four evaluated models. Retrieved context increased the mean agreement with historical action directions by 22.4–42.7 percentage points, whereas the contribution of visual evidence was model-dependent. Under supervised operation on five ion sources, integrating parameter write-back, programmable logic controller (PLC) execution, and waveform read-back, the system achieved a beam-extraction rate of 86.80% across 409 executed shots. These results demonstrate the engineering feasibility of the framework for supervised sequential tuning on a physical scientific instrument and provide a basis for evaluating autonomous closed-loop operation and cross-device generalization.

paragraphs.en: Frontier scientific discovery increasingly relies on complex scientific instruments to create extreme experimental conditions and acquire high-quality, reproducible observations. As these instruments grow in scale and control dimensionality, bringing them efficiently into reliable operation and making effective use of limited experimental opportunities have become critical to converting major experimental infrastructure into scientific output. Autonomous experimentation offers a potential route by organizing measurement, decision-making, and execution into iterative closed loops [ 1 , 2 ] . In physical experiments, however, aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties continue to limit the reproducibility and robust operation of closed-loop systems [ 3 ] . Reliable decisions across successive operations become particularly difficult when the instrument response depends on operational history, important operating conditions are not directly observable, and no high-fidelity simulator is available for repeatable interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿科学发现日益依赖复杂的科学仪器来创造极端实验条件并获取高质量、可复现的观测数据。 随着这些仪器在规模和控制维度上不断增长，如何高效地使其进入可靠运行状态，并有效利用有限的实验机会，已成为将重大实验基础设施转化为科学产出的关键。 自主实验通过将测量、决策与执行组织成迭代的闭环，提供了一条潜在的途径 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 然而，在物理实验中，偶然不确定性与认知不确定性持续限制着闭环系统的可复现性和稳健运行 [ 3 ] 。 当仪器响应依赖于运行历史、关键运行条件无法直接观测、且没有高保真模拟器可供可重复交互时，跨连续运行的可靠决策变得尤为困难。

paragraphs.en: Nuclear fusion is regarded as an important pathway toward meeting long-term demand for clean and safe energy [ 4 ] . As magnetic-confinement fusion devices progress toward high-performance, long-pulse operation, stable auxiliary heating and current drive are essential for plasma heating, confinement, and scenario sustainment [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Neutral beam injection (NBI) can deliver megawatt-level heating power, while its beam energy and injection direction can be used to regulate energy deposition and momentum input. It is therefore one of the principal auxiliary-heating techniques for tokamaks and other magnetic-confinement fusion devices [ 10 , 8 , 11 ] . Before operation, an NBI ion source and its high-voltage acceleration system generally require repeated tuning: an experimental operator sets the discharge and extraction parameters, triggers a discharge, inspects the resulting multichannel waveforms, and then adjusts the parameters for the next shot. Tuning a large NBI ion source may take weeks to months and involve hundreds to thousands of high-voltage or beam pulses [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] . This experience-dependent, shot-to-shot tuning process directly affects NBI operational efficiency and is representative of the sequential decision-making problem encountered in scientific instruments.
paragraphs.zh: 核聚变被视为满足长期清洁安全能源需求的重要途径 [ 4 ] 。 随着磁约束聚变装置向高性能、长脉冲运行推进，稳定的辅助加热与电流驱动对于等离子体加热、约束以及运行方案的维持至关重要 [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 中性束注入（NBI）能够提供兆瓦级的加热功率，同时其束流能量和注入方向可用于调节能量沉积与动量输入。 因此，它是托卡马克及其他磁约束聚变装置的主要辅助加热技术之一 [ 10 , 8 , 11 ] 。 在运行之前，NBI 离子源及其高压加速系统通常需要反复调试：实验操作员设定放电和引出参数，触发一次放电，检查所产生的多通道波形，然后为下一次放电（shot）调整参数。 调试一台大型 NBI 离子源可能需要数周至数月，并涉及数百到数千次高压脉冲或束流脉冲 [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] 。 这种依赖经验、逐炮进行的调试过程直接影响 NBI 的运行效率，是科学仪器中常见的序贯决策问题的典型代表。

paragraphs.en: Ion-source tuning is not a routine parameter-optimization problem defined by a fixed mapping from parameters to performance. Important operating conditions, including electrode-surface state, vacuum cleanliness, and coating condition, are difficult to measure directly and cannot be reset in a controlled manner between shots. Consequently, measured outcomes may vary from shot to shot under identical control settings, as shown in Fig. 1 . Moreover, no high-fidelity simulator currently provides a reliable account of shot-to-shot response changes, while exploration on the physical system is costly and risky. The task is therefore more appropriately formulated as a constrained sequential decision-making problem with history-dependent response variation and incomplete observations.
paragraphs.zh: 离子源调谐并非一个由参数到性能的固定映射所定义的常规参数优化问题。 一些重要的运行条件，包括电极表面状态、真空洁净度和镀膜状况，难以直接测量，且无法在发次之间以受控方式进行复位。 因此，在相同的控制设置下，测量结果可能随发次而变化，如图1所示。 此外，目前尚无高保真仿真器能够可靠地解释发次间响应的变化，而在物理系统上进行探索既昂贵又有风险。 因此，该任务更适宜被表述为一个具有历史依赖响应变化和不完备观测的受限序贯决策问题。

paragraphs.en: Machine learning has been applied in fusion devices to tasks including plasma-configuration control, confinement-regime identification, and disruption prediction [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . Within NBI research, neural networks have been used to accelerate NUBEAM and related NBI-effect and transport simulations [ 18 , 19 ] ; surrogate models and evolutionary algorithms, such as genetic algorithms (GA) and particle swarm optimization (PSO), have been used to learn relationships between ion-source parameters and performance [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] ; and neural networks have also been investigated for predicting ion-source breakdown [ 26 ] . These studies indicate the potential of simulation-driven control and historical-data modeling for fusion devices and ion-source optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 机器学习已被应用于聚变装置中的多项任务，包括等离子体位形控制、约束区间识别和破裂预测 [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] 。 在中性束注入（NBI）研究中，神经网络已被用于加速 NUBEAM 及相关的 NBI 效应与输运模拟 [ 18 , 19 ] ；代理模型和演化算法，如遗传算法（GA）和粒子群优化（PSO），已被用于学习离子源参数与性能之间的关系 [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] ；神经网络还被研究用于预测离子源击穿 [ 26 ] 。 这些研究表明了模拟驱动的控制以及历史数据建模在聚变装置和离子源优化方面的潜力。

paragraphs.en: For the ion-source tuning task considered here, these approaches face distinct challenges under the presently available data and device conditions. Reinforcement learning (RL) generally requires either a high-fidelity simulator or extensive interaction with the physical system. Existing models do not yet reproduce shot-to-shot response changes with sufficient accuracy, whereas trial-and-error operation on the physical system is costly and risky. Standard Bayesian optimization is suitable for parameter optimization with expensive observations, and safe variants can provide conditional safety guarantees; however, when the unobserved device state changes across shots, standard or safe Bayesian optimization alone is still insufficient to address latent-state drift directly [ 27 , 28 ] . Static supervised models that predict outcomes from only the current parameters are poorly suited to exploiting complete tuning trajectories, waveform morphology, and unstructured operating procedures. These limitations point to the same set of missing capabilities: a representation of state across shots, conditioning on operational history, and explicit action constraints before execution.

paragraphs.en: When neither a suitable simulator nor direct estimation of the latent state is available, a practical alternative is to avoid explicitly reconstructing that state. Instead, the current decision can be conditioned on the recent trajectory of actions and outcomes, retaining traceable cross-shot context without relying on a difficult-to-validate state estimate. Large language model agents have begun to be applied to robotic decision-making [ 29 , 30 ] and can organize iterative scientific experimental workflows through knowledge retrieval and tool use [ 31 , 32 ] . However, observations from scientific instruments include high-frequency time series, waveform images, and equipment states, and time-series data commonly require joint representation with other modalities [ 37 ] . This work therefore separates deterministic measurement from multimodal reasoning, rather than relying on a general-purpose model to replace quantitative readout. Likewise, semantic guardrails or external validators [ 38 ] and model-based shielding [ 39 ] can constrain agent behavior, but they are not equivalent to a deterministic action-membership check against device-permitted bounds.

paragraphs.en: We propose a physics-grounded multimodal agent for NBI ion-source tuning. The system first uses deterministic algorithms to extract verifiable physical quantities from raw waveforms and anchors waveform images with those quantities. It then generates a candidate action for the next shot by jointly using the recent trajectory of the current task, historical experience, and operating procedures. Finally, before parameters are written, an independent action feasibility check evaluates parameter bounds, per-shot rates of change, and documented exclusion regions. Evidence integration and action proposal are thus assigned to the MLLM, and parameter execution and equipment protection remain with the PLC and hardware interlocks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一种面向NBI离子源调谐的物理接地多模态智能体。 该系统首先使用确定性算法从原始波形中提取可验证的物理量，并将波形图像与这些物理量进行锚定。 随后，系统联合利用当前任务的近期轨迹、历史经验和操作规程，为下一炮生成候选动作。 最后，在参数写入之前，由独立的动作可行性检查评估参数边界、每炮变化率以及文档中规定的禁用区间。 因此，证据整合与动作提议由MLLM承担，而参数执行与设备保护仍由PLC和硬件联锁负责。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows:

paragraphs.en: Problem formulation and layered decision architecture. We formulate NBI ion-source tuning as a constrained sequential decision-making problem with no available high-fidelity simulator and a partially observed latent device state (Section 2.2 ). On this basis, we delineate the responsibilities of deterministic measurement, evidence retrieval, strategy proposal, and the action feasibility check, such that quantitative readout and execution constraints are handled by deterministic modules and the MLLM concentrates on evidence integration and strategy proposal (Sections 3 and 3.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 问题形式化与分层决策架构。 我们将NBI离子源调谐形式化为一个约束序贯决策问题，该问题没有可用的高保真模拟器，且设备潜在状态只能部分观测（第2.2节）。 在此基础上，我们界定了确定性测量、证据检索、策略生成和动作可行性检查各自的职责，使定量读数和执行约束由确定性模块处理，而多模态大语言模型专注于证据整合与策略生成（第3节和第3.5节）。

paragraphs.en: Beam formation and injection in an NBI system can be divided into four stages: ion production, electrostatic extraction and acceleration, gas neutralization, and neutral-beam injection into the plasma [ 43 , 44 ] . This study focuses on ion production and electrostatic extraction and acceleration. The ion source under study uses a hot-cathode arc discharge and a multicusp magnetic field, and consists primarily of a discharge chamber and a three-electrode accelerator, as shown in Fig. 2 . The three electrodes are, in sequence, the plasma grid, suppression grid, and ground grid [ 45 ] . Heated filaments emit primary electrons, which are accelerated by the arc voltage and ionize the gas through collisions, thereby forming a plasma in the discharge chamber. By suppressing electron losses to the chamber wall, the multicusp magnetic field extends the electron confinement time and affects both the density and spatial uniformity of the plasma. The resulting ions are subsequently extracted, accelerated, and focused through multi-aperture grids.

paragraphs.en: Shot-to-shot tuning involves five principal control variables—acceleration voltage, filament voltage, arc voltage, gas flow rate, and suppression voltage—which correspond to mutually coupled physical processes. The acceleration voltage primarily determines the energy of individual ions, but the beam current is also jointly constrained by the ion supply and the transport capacity of the accelerator. The filament voltage affects thermionic electron emission; the arc voltage affects the energy of primary electrons and the arc-discharge intensity; and the gas flow rate affects plasma production through the discharge pressure and may also alter collisions, beam loss, and breakdown conditions in the acceleration region. The suppression voltage is used to suppress secondary and backstreaming electrons. An increase in gas pressure or arc current may also increase the suppression-grid current and its ratio to the acceleration current [ 43 , 45 ] . The effect of any single parameter therefore depends on the other settings and the current device state, and tuning cannot be reduced to a set of independent univariate adjustments.
paragraphs.zh: 逐次调束涉及五个主要控制变量——加速电压、灯丝电压、电弧电压、气体流量和抑制电压，它们对应着相互耦合的物理过程。 加速电压主要决定单个离子的能量，但束流还同时受离子供给和加速器传输能力的共同约束。 灯丝电压影响热电子发射；电弧电压影响原初电子的能量和电弧放电强度；气体流量则通过放电气压影响等离子体的产生，还可能改变加速区的碰撞、束流损失和击穿条件。 抑制电压用于抑制二次电子和回流电子。 气压或电弧电流的增大也可能使抑制栅电流及其与加速电流的比值增大 [ 43 , 45 ] 。 因此，任何单一参数的作用都取决于其他参数设置和装置当前状态，调束不能简化为一组相互独立的单变量调整。

paragraphs.en: Ion-source tuning aims to progressively improve discharge stability and the high-voltage hold-off capability of the accelerator. During repeated discharges, quantities such as the microscopic condition of electrode surfaces, adsorbed gas, and vacuum conditions may continue to evolve. Gas breakdown, surface flashover, beam interception, secondary-electron emission, and backstreaming-electron bombardment can induce electrode overcurrent, beam oscillation, or arcing. These factors cannot be measured comprehensively between shots but can affect subsequent discharge outcomes. For conciseness, they are collectively termed the “latent device state” in this work. We assess the operational quality of the discharge and extraction processes using voltage, current, and other discharge waveforms. Beam-optics quantities, including spatial uniformity, divergence angle, neutralization efficiency, and the neutral-beam power injected into the plasma, are characterized by dedicated beam diagnostics and can be incorporated as additional tuning objectives in future work.

paragraphs.en: This shot-to-shot tuning problem has three defining characteristics. First, no high-fidelity simulator validated against device data is currently available that can jointly predict P meas P_{\mathrm{meas}} and P dyn P_{\mathrm{dyn}} . Second, sampling on the physical system is costly: under the standard workflow of the device considered here, executing a shot and reading back its outcome typically takes 3–5 min, while an unsuitable action may also cause arcing, electrode overcurrent, or additional recovery procedures. Third, the latent device state z t z_{t} is not directly observable and may evolve across shots. Consequently, after marginalizing over this state, the action–response distribution may vary with operational history. Such evolution does not imply monotonic improvement of the device state with shot number; chamber opening, contamination accumulation, or repeated arcing may instead degrade the state. An empirical analysis of outcome inconsistency among neighboring actions is presented in Section 5.1 .

paragraphs.en: This section presents the implementation of the physics-grounded multimodal agent. In this study, physics grounding refers to evidence represented by deterministic physical-quantity symbols extracted from measurements. The method comprises three core mechanisms: (1) deterministic algorithms extract auditable physical symbols from multichannel waveforms and combine them with visual evidence from the acceleration-current channel to form a multimodal representation; (2) a short-term in-task trajectory is integrated with long-term experience and procedural knowledge to provide traceable context for policy generation under latent-state evolution; and (3) candidate action generation is decoupled from constrained execution, with human intervention triggered under abnormal operating conditions or when the system cannot recover autonomously. The overall system architecture is shown in Fig. 3 , and the complete shot-level decision loop is given in Algorithm 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍基于物理的多模态智能体的实现。 在本研究中，物理接地是指由从测量数据中提取的确定性物理量符号所表示的证据。 该方法包含三个核心机制：(1) 确定性算法从多通道波形中提取可审计的物理符号，并将其与电流-加速度通道的视觉证据相结合，形成多模态表示；(2) 将任务内短期轨迹与长期经验和程序性知识相集成，在潜在状态演化下为策略生成提供可追溯的上下文；(3) 候选动作生成与受约束执行相解耦，在异常运行工况下或系统无法自主恢复时触发人工干预。 系统总体架构如图3所示，完整的镜头级决策循环见算法1。

paragraphs.en: To ensure the auditability of the symbolic state s ^ t \hat{s}_{t} , the grounding operator Φ \Phi performs quantitative analysis only on observations that satisfy the completeness requirements. A channel c c is marked as missing if 𝐘 t ( c ) \mathbf{Y}_{t}^{(c)} is absent or contains no valid samples. paragraphs.en: Breakdowns are generally caused by electrode overcurrent induced by interelectrode gas breakdown, surface flashover, or particle bombardment. In the waveforms, they appear as a brief surge in acceleration current followed by a rapid decrease, accompanied by a drop in acceleration voltage. In this work, “breakdown” refers specifically to transient breakdown or overcurrent events and excludes the steady-state suppression-grid current arising from beam divergence, secondary-electron emission, or gap-impact ionization [ 45 ] . The detection algorithm applies both current and voltage criteria. The current must first reach I hi = 2.0 I_{\mathrm{hi}}=2.0 A and then fall below this threshold after remaining high for less than Δ ​ t bd = 10 \Delta t_{\mathrm{bd}}=10 ms. The program uses the mean acceleration voltage during the first 0.1 s after the start of the record, V 1 V_{1} , as the low-level baseline, and sets V 1 + V off V_{1}+V_{\mathrm{off}} ( V off = 5 V_{\mathrm{off}}=5 kV) as the voltage low-level threshold. Within the window from the onset of the current-threshold crossing to Δ ​ t off = 50 \Delta t_{\mathrm{off}}=50 ms after the current falls back, the minimum acceleration voltage must also be below this threshold. Only when both the current and voltage conditions are satisfied does the system identify the event as a breakdown and record its start and end times, duration, minimum voltage, and the time at which that minimum occurs. Here, V off V_{\mathrm{off}} is the threshold offset relative to the pre-discharge low-level baseline, rather than the magnitude of the operating-voltage drop.

paragraphs.en: The system renders the acceleration-current waveform as a uniformly formatted annotated image I t I_{t} and supplies it directly to the multimodal model for interpretation. The image represents the overall discharge morphology and helps verify whether the physical quantities extracted by Φ \Phi are consistent with the visible structure. To maintain shot-level correspondence between the visual evidence and symbolic state, the raw waveform, I t I_{t} , and s ^ t \hat{s}_{t} are linked by the unique shot number in MDSplus. The symbolic state s ^ t \hat{s}_{t} provides quantitative information such as amplitude, pulse width, and flat-top interval, together with state information including channel-missing, breakdown, oscillation, and fault indicators. Before invoking the model, the system performs deterministic checks based on the completeness and fault flags in s ^ t \hat{s}_{t} . The image I t I_{t} enables the multimodal model to identify the overall morphology and locations of local anomalies and assists in cross-checking the physical quantities above; c t c_{t} provides the operator instructions and operating constraints for the current shot; and a t a_{t} denotes the control parameters executed for the current shot. These fields are expanded hierarchically when the model is invoked, with I t I_{t} supplied as image input. Cross-shot changes are not supplied as a separate field; instead, the model compares the chronologically ordered shot-level records in h t ST h_{t}^{\mathrm{ST}} . Consistency between the image and symbolic state is assessed by the multimodal model in context. paragraphs.en: The short-term memory Memory t ST \Mem_{t}^{\mathrm{ST}} stores the continuous trajectory of the most recent shots in the current task. paragraphs.en: The multimodal planner receives the current symbolic state, waveform image, textual context, executed control parameters, retrieved context, and task objective. It generates a structured report at three levels: state diagnosis, assessment of possible causes, and policy planning. paragraphs.en: Within the predefined task objective and device operating boundaries, a candidate action is written to the PLC only after passing an independent action feasibility check. If a critical channel is missing, the current waveform state is unidentifiable, the feasible set is empty, or the check fails, the system refuses dispatch and requests operator intervention. paragraphs.en: The experiments covered four independent ion-source platforms of the EXL-50U neutral beam injection system. Each platform was equipped with an independent ion source, control system, and data acquisition system, and differed in power-supply characteristics, vacuum conditions, and electrode states. The unified offline evaluation set comprised historical records from 455 shots. Multiple experts jointly reviewed the raw multichannel waveforms and reached a single consensus label through discussion, assigning each sample to one of six classes: full breakdown, insufficient pulse width, long-pulse high current, long-pulse low current, high-frequency oscillation, and fault noise. This discharge-quality taxonomy defines the label space for the classification metrics reported in this study. The platform-specific sample sizes were 127 shots from Test Bench 1, 116 from Test Bench 2, 110 from Experimental Bench 1, and 102 from Experimental Bench 2. Here, “platform” denotes a complete ion-source, control, and acquisition system, whereas “ion source” denotes the physical ion-generating component within that system. Offline records are identified at the platform level, whereas online records are further identified by the individual ion source within each platform.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 summarizes the six-class consensus labels obtained through direct expert review of the raw multichannel waveforms. The human ground truth was not generated by the grounding operator Φ \Phi or by model outputs. On the model side, the number of flat tops, pulse width, current amplitude, and breakdown flag were read from the structured report generated under each configuration and mapped to the same six classes using a common prespecified rule: n flat = 0 n_{\mathrm{flat}}=0 with breakdown was classified as full breakdown; n flat = 0 n_{\mathrm{flat}}=0 without breakdown as fault noise; n flat ≥ 2 n_{\mathrm{flat}}\geq 2 as high-frequency oscillation; and cases with n flat = 1 n_{\mathrm{flat}}=1 were assigned to the remaining three classes according to pulse width and current amplitude. The criterion n flat ≥ 2 n_{\mathrm{flat}}\geq 2 for high-frequency oscillation was motivated by interruption and subsequent re-establishment of the acceleration current within a single shot, which corresponded to oscillation-induced power drops in this dataset. paragraphs.en: The evaluation comprised four levels. First, for quantitative readout, the acceleration-current amplitude, pulse width, and number of flat tops in each structured report were compared with the reference values of the evaluation set using the mean absolute error (MAE) and root-mean-square error (RMSE). Under Baseline, this level measures how accurately the model recovers these quantities from waveform images; under Physical-only and all subsequent configurations, the corresponding quantities extracted by Φ \Phi were included in the prompt, and the same metrics measure how accurately the model reports them when deterministic readings are available. Second, the direct quality-classification field in the model’s structured report was evaluated using Accuracy and macro-F 1 , hereafter termed quality-classification macro-F 1 . Third, to assess whether the physical fields in the model report support its classification conclusion, a separate six-class prediction was generated from the reported number of flat tops, pulse width, current amplitude, and breakdown flag using the prespecified mapping described in the preceding subsection, and macro-F 1 was computed against the same expert consensus labels. This metric is hereafter termed field-derived six-class macro-F 1 . These are two distinct readouts from the same report and are not interchangeable. Fourth, the flat-top, breakdown, and continuous-value outputs of Φ \Phi were evaluated independently of the large language model. Operator outputs were matched by shot identifier to the human reference labels across the four platforms. We report MAE for acceleration current and main flat-top width, exact-count accuracy for flat tops and breakdowns, and count-based event F 1 .

When the threshold was changed to 0.02 and 0.10, the conflict rates were 55.5% (1307 pairs) and 58.3% (3990 pairs), respectively. paragraphs.en: The comparison between Physical-only and +Physical reveals clear model dependence in the effect of visual input on quality classification, action direction, and continuous-value errors. For Qwen3-VL-Plus, quality-classification macro-F 1 increased by 0.15 and directional agreement by 11.2 percentage points. For MiniMax3 and GLM-5.3-Flash, macro-F 1 increased by only 0.01, while directional agreement changed by − 3.1 -3.1 and − 1.8 -1.8 percentage points, respectively. For Qwen3.5-Plus, macro-F 1 decreased by 0.06, whereas directional agreement increased by 1.4 percentage points. Current MAE decreased for MiniMax3 and GLM-5.3-Flash, and pulse-width MAE decreased for MiniMax3 and Qwen3-VL-Plus, with MiniMax3 improving on both quantities. These results indicate that the visual channel primarily contributes global structural information, including flat-top interruption, waveform oscillation, and cross-channel morphology, and that the efficiency with which this information is used depends on the model’s visual parsing capability. Physical symbols and visual evidence therefore serve complementary functions: the former supply local quantitative readings, and the latter supply global waveform structure.

paragraphs.en: The results establish a clear division of labor among the modules: physical symbols provide a quantitatively stable baseline across models, visual evidence supplements model-dependent waveform morphology, and historical retrieval substantially strengthens cross-shot action-direction reproduction. This pattern is consistent with the action-neighbor conflict analysis in Section 5.1 , indicating that historical trajectories contain decision-relevant information beyond the current-shot observation when the latent device state is not directly observable. The shared trends across the four models further suggest that the principal gains arise from input construction and evidence organization rather than dependence on a single foundation model. The symbolic-grounding, memory-retrieval, and feasibility-check interfaces can therefore remain stable while the foundation model is replaced according to deployment requirements. Section 5.3 uses Qwen3-VL-Plus Full for supervised execution on the physical system.

paragraphs.en: To further assess the deployability and operational stability of the proposed method on a physical scientific instrument, the Qwen3-VL-Plus Full configuration, which achieved the best offline evaluation results, was integrated with EXL-50U for supervised shot-to-shot execution. The on-device validation comprised two complementary levels. Long-term operation across multiple ion sources and comparison with historical manual-tuning records were used to assess cross-source engineering reliability. paragraphs.en: Building on the routine-operation validation, we further examined whether operating conditions progressed toward their targets over successive shots using three consecutive experiments on the same ion source at Test Bench 2. All three experiments performed shot-to-shot tuning toward prespecified targets, and the system protocol generated the next-shot recommendation from feedback on the preceding shot. The corresponding shot ranges were 11394–11402, 11884–11891, and 11948–11953, totaling 23 shots; these shots were also a subset of the 49 operational records for that ion source. The available archive provides complete outcome-level trajectories for testing whether the observed responses evolved consistently with progressive parameter adjustment, thereby supporting an outcome-based assessment of target-oriented tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 在常规运行验证的基础上，我们进一步利用在2号试验台同一离子源上连续进行的三次实验，考察运行条件是否在逐次炮间朝其目标推进。 三次实验均进行了逐炮向预定目标调谐，系统协议根据前一炮的反馈生成下一炮的推荐。 相应的炮号范围分别为11394–11402、11884–11891和11948–11953，共计23炮；这些炮也是该离子源49条运行记录的一个子集。 现有存档提供了完整的结果级轨迹，可用于检验所观测到的响应是否随参数逐步调整而一致演化，从而支持基于结果的面向目标调谐评估。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, a shot was considered to contain a valid beam interval if the absolute acceleration current reached 1 A continuously for at least 10 ms. The duration of the longest continuous interval was taken as the beam pulse width, and the median acceleration voltage and acceleration current within that interval were calculated. This waveform-based criterion serves a different purpose from the record-based criterion used in the multi-source summary: the former constructs auditable shot-to-shot response trajectories, whereas the latter summarizes shot-level beam extraction outcomes in the existing operational records.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，若绝对加速电流连续达到 1 A 并持续至少 10 ms，则认为该炮次包含一个有效的束流区间。 最长连续区间的持续时间被取为束流脉冲宽度，并计算该区间内加速电压与加速电流的中位数。 这种基于波形的判据与多源汇总中所用的基于记录的判据目的不同：前者构建可审计的逐炮响应轨迹，后者则总结现有运行记录中炮级层面的束流引出结果。

paragraphs.en: In Fig. 8 , the operating parameters in all three experiments exhibited an overall stepwise increase during shot-to-shot tuning. In the context of the on-site tuning process, these outcomes reflect the greater state-matching demands of operation in the high-parameter regime: after the parameters are increased, multiple rounds of shot-to-shot adjustment are typically required to progressively improve the ion-source state and establish stable beam extraction at the higher operating level. These terminal shots therefore represent transitional tuning states during continued advancement into the high-parameter regime, while all three trajectories retain a clear overall direction of increasing the operating parameters.

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the multi-source records support supervised integration and routine operation of the system across different ion sources, and the comparison with manual records provides a reference level under the same device conditions. The three consecutive experiments further show that, under the target-oriented protocol, continuous shot-to-shot tuning advanced operation from a lower-parameter regime toward higher voltage and current while allowing continued iterative improvement of the ion-source state at the higher operating level. The response trajectories therefore support the system’s target-oriented parameter-advancement capability.

paragraphs.en: The findings collectively support a central interpretation: shot-to-shot tuning of a scientific instrument is continual adaptation to a device state that evolves with operational history. Different quality outcomes among neighboring actions, together with their dependence on inter-shot separation, indicate that history is an essential component for characterizing the current operating condition and organizing the next-shot decision. The central role of the MLLM in this framework is therefore to use traceable cross-shot context to address the information gap created by an unobserved latent state.

sents.zh: 因此，多模态大语言模型在该框架中的核心作用，是利用可追溯的跨发次上下文来弥合由未被观测到的潜在状态所造成的信息鸿沟。

paragraphs.en: The cross-model and on-device results further reveal the complementary roles of the three system components. Deterministic physical symbols answer what occurred in the current shot; history-conditioned memory addresses how the next action should be adjusted in light of the observed trajectory; and the independent feasibility check determines whether the candidate adjustment can be dispatched safely. This separation maintains clear responsibility boundaries among shot-level measurement, cross-shot reasoning, and action execution, and helps explain why the overall pattern remains consistent when the foundation model is changed. During consecutive physical experiments, transient mismatches in the high-parameter regime reflected the need for multiple interactions to condition the ion-source state. Continued advancement toward the target demonstrates that history-conditioned decision-making naturally represents the practical cycle of increasing parameters, observing the response, improving the source state, and advancing again. Operation across multiple sources and comparison with manual records further indicate that the method has progressed from offline behavioral reproduction to supervised physical operation at an engineering-relevant level.
paragraphs.zh: 跨模型与设备端的结果进一步揭示了三个系统组件的互补作用。 确定性的物理符号回答了当前发次中发生了什么；以历史为条件的记忆解决如何根据观测到的轨迹调整下一步动作；而独立的可行性检查则决定候选调整能否被安全地下发执行。 这种划分在发次级测量、跨发次推理与动作执行之间保持了清晰的责任边界，并有助于解释为何在更换基础模型时整体模式仍保持一致。 在连续的物理实验过程中，高参数区间出现的短暂不匹配反映出需要多次交互才能使离子源状态进入条件。 持续向目标推进表明，以历史为条件的决策自然地体现了提高参数、观察响应、改善源状态、再继续推进这一实际循环。 跨多台源设备的运行以及与人工记录的对比进一步表明，该方法已从离线的行为复现发展到具有工程相关水平的受监督物理操作。

paragraphs.en: The broader significance of this work extends beyond ion-source operation. For scientific instruments that lack high-fidelity simulators, exhibit history-dependent latent-state evolution, and impose high costs per experiment, deterministic measurement, history-conditioned decision-making, and action constraints can be organized as modular interfaces. This organization permits foundation models to be replaced or upgraded while preserving a traceable evidence chain and the existing protection hierarchy of the instrument. The next stage can progress from engineering feasibility to quantitative performance gains and higher-autonomy operation through unified logging of shot-level targets, candidate actions, check outcomes, executed actions, human interventions, and waveform outcomes. Contemporaneous comparisons with matched tasks and device states, together with cross-device evaluation, expanded decrease-action samples, shots to first target attainment, abnormal-event rates, and independent retrieval ablations, will enable systematic characterization of sample efficiency, transferability, and closed-loop tuning benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作的更广泛意义超越了离子源运行本身。 对于缺乏高保真模拟器、表现出依赖历史的潜在状态演化、且每次实验成本高昂的科学仪器，可以将确定性测量、以历史为条件的决策以及动作约束组织为模块化接口。 这种组织方式允许替换或升级基础模型，同时保留可追溯的证据链以及仪器既有的保护层级。 通过对炮级目标、候选动作、检查结果、执行动作、人工干预和波形结果的统一记录，下一阶段可以从工程可行性推进到量化性能提升和更高自主性的运行。 通过在匹配任务与装置状态下的同期对比，以及跨装置评估、扩充的降级动作样本、首次达成目标所需炮数、异常事件率和独立检索消融实验，将能够系统地刻画样本效率、可迁移性和闭环调优收益。

paragraphs.en: Scientific-instrument responses can evolve with latent operating conditions and operational history, making tuning strategies based on a static action–response mapping unreliable across successive operations. Taking NBI ion-source tuning as a representative setting, this study develops a multimodal agent for adaptive tuning under nonstationary responses. Deterministic signal processing converts raw waveforms into auditable physical symbols and visual evidence; a dual-layer memory conditions next-shot decisions on within-task trajectories, cross-task experience, and procedural knowledge; and an independent feasibility layer checks candidate actions before dispatch. This separation assigns evidence integration and candidate-action generation to the MLLM while retaining quantitative measurement and final protection within deterministic algorithms, the PLC, and hardware interlocks.
paragraphs.zh: 科学仪器的响应会随潜在运行工况和操作历史而演化，这使得基于静态动作–响应映射的调谐策略在连续运行中不可靠。 以NBI离子源调谐作为代表性场景，本研究开发了一个多模态智能体，用于非平稳响应下的自适应调谐。 确定性信号处理将原始波形转换为可审计的物理符号和视觉证据；双层记忆基于任务内轨迹、跨任务经验和程序性知识来约束下一炮决策；独立的可行性层在指令下发前检查候选动作。 这种分离将证据整合和候选动作生成交给多模态大语言模型，同时将定量测量和最终保护保留在确定性算法、PLC和硬件联锁之中。

paragraphs.en: The experimental results support the framework at three levels. First, the quality-outcome conflict rate was 54.7% among action-neighbor shot pairs and remained 44.1% for pairs with identical parameters; its increase with inter-shot separation demonstrates the importance of operational history to the device response. Second, across 455 matched records from four platforms, the grounding operator achieved pooled MAEs of 0.68 A for acceleration current and 10.42 ms for main flat-top width, with event-count F 1 values of 97.61% for flat tops and 99.66% for breakdowns. In strict chronological replay of the same records, physical symbols increased quality-classification macro-F 1 by 0.21–0.32 relative to waveform images alone across four models, while retrieved context increased mean directional agreement by 22.4–42.7 percentage points. These results verify the complementary roles of reliable physical representation and history-conditioned decision-making. Third, the system completed 409 shots of physical execution across five ion sources with an overall beam-extraction rate of 86.80%. On four comparable sources, the beam-extraction rates were 86.11% for supervised agent tuning and 83.83% for manual-tuning records. All three consecutive experiments advanced the operating parameters toward higher levels, demonstrating target-oriented progression and continued source conditioning in the high-parameter regime.
paragraphs.zh: 实验结果在三个层面支持了该框架。 首先，在动作相邻的炮对之间，质量结果冲突率为 54.7%，而在参数完全相同的炮对之间仍为 44.1%；该冲突率随炮间间隔的增大而上升，表明操作历史对装置响应的重要性。 其次，在来自四个平台的 455 条匹配记录上，接地算子（grounding operator）在加速电流上的合并平均绝对误差（MAE）为 0.68 A，在主平顶宽度上为 10.42 ms，事件计数的 F1 值分别为平顶 97.61%、击穿 99.66%。 在对相同记录进行严格按时间顺序回放时，相较于仅使用波形图像，物理符号使四个模型的质量分类宏观 F1 提升了 0.21–0.32，而检索到的上下文使平均方向一致率提升了 22.4–42.7 个百分点。 这些结果验证了可靠物理表征与基于历史的决策二者的互补作用。 第三，该系统在五种离子源上完成了 409 炮的物理执行，总体束流引出率为 86.80%。 在四个可比较的离子源上，有监督智能体调谐的束流引出率为 86.11%，人工调谐记录的束流引出率为 83.83%。 连续三次实验都将运行参数推向更高水平，展现了面向目标的推进以及高参数区间下的持续源锻炼。

paragraphs.en: This work therefore establishes a simulator-free route for tuning scientific instruments with nonstationary responses by combining history-conditioned decision-making with deterministic measurement and constrained execution. Its central contribution is to embed a multimodal model within an auditable, replaceable, and protection-compatible shot-to-shot decision architecture, in which the model works alongside deterministic physical measurement and the existing safety controls. The resulting framework provides a transferable methodological basis for other scientific instruments characterized by history dependence, partial observability, and expensive experimentation, while creating the experimental and engineering foundation for subsequent quantification of closed-loop benefit, sample efficiency, and cross-device generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这项工作通过将基于历史的决策与确定性测量和受约束执行相结合，为调谐具有非平稳响应的科学仪器确立了一条无需仿真器的路线。 其核心贡献是将一个多模态模型嵌入到可审计、可更换且与保护机制兼容的逐发次决策架构中，在该架构中，该模型与确定性物理测量以及现有安全控制协同工作。 所得到的框架为其他以历史依赖性、部分可观测性和高成本实验为特征的科学仪器提供了可迁移的方法学基础，同时为后续对闭环收益、样本效率和跨设备泛化能力的量化创建了实验与工程基础。
